movelist.name: Earthquake
movelist.effect: Earthquake can hit targets that are underground, including those using the Move Dig.

movelist.name: Zen Headbutt
movelist.effect: Zen Headbutt Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Snore
movelist.effect: Snore Flinches all legal targets on 15+. Snore may only be used by Sleeping users.

movelist.name: Rest
movelist.effect: The user is set to their full Hit Point value. The user is cured of any Status ailments. Then, the user falls Asleep. The user cannot make Sleep Checks at the beginning of their turn. They are cured of the Sleep at the end of their turn in 2 rounds.

movelist.name: Magnitude
movelist.effect: When you use Magnitude, roll 1d6.  Magnitude’s Damage Base is equal to 5+X, where X is the value of the d6. Magnitude can hit targets that are underground, including those using the Move Dig.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the Enraged and Infatuated conditions. Defensive.

abilities.name: Mud Dweller
abilities.effect: The user resists Ground-Type and Water-Type attacks one step further.
